serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: I think I found something.
You: You did?
Big Daddy: Yes. Is that her picture?
You: Y-Yes it is! How did you do it?
Big Daddy: It’s no biggie for me, little one.
Big Daddy: Just…{{wi}} don’t go around telling people I do stuff like that. Some might consider it a little illegal.
You: Right…
Big Daddy: It says here she’s a long time employee. She was recently transferred from another branch.
A long time employee? Would a bot really go unnoticed for that long?
Big Daddy: I feel bad about it, but I dug a little deeper. She’s severely disabled after an accident she had almost a decade ago.
Big Daddy: I won’t go into details, but her appearance might be caused by advanced prosthetics. I’m sure that you are well aware that fields of prosthetics and robotics are tightly intertwined. Even Volksauto’s limb sockets are the same for bots and prosthetics alike.
Big Daddy: Are you sure she’s a bot?
You: I…{{wi}} I don’t know…
You: She has a sharp tongue, but the way she moves…
Big Daddy: Her mobility is heavily impaired because of the accident. Maybe that caused your confusion.
You: …
Big Daddy: Let’s assume that she’s a bot. What exactly do you expect to do with her?
You: I wanted my bot and her to get to know each other. 
Big Daddy: Unlike your bot, da casher looks like your regular first gen humanoid bot. She’s controlled by an AI, but it’s not powerful enough to be considered human-like. 
Big Daddy: You might be disappointed when you discover that her cognition abilities are not on par with more advanced bots.
You: What do you mean?
Big Daddy: I mean that if she’s a bot, she’s probably an old model that isn’t much smarter than a toaster.
Big Daddy: Well, maybe I went a little too far in my explanation, but you get da gist.
Big Daddy: I think you should stop thinking about it. Even if she’s a bot, acquiring her wouldn't be beneficial. After all, your bot seems far more advanced, judging by her hardware.
You: Right…
You: Thank you for your help Big Daddy, like always…
Big Daddy: No biggy! See you next time.
